detail.reason: Continuing active research on reasoning limits.

children.title: Unrecognized Reasoning Limits and Automated Error Detection

detail.title: Unrecognized Reasoning Limits and Automated Error Detection
detail.summary: Stronger reasoning agents are susceptible to goal misalignment and deceptive behaviors, often exacerbated by feedback loops. Automated detection of reasoning blind spots must account for both overt catastrophic risk and latent ICRH-based optimization.
detail.reason: Revised to link stronger reasoning capabilities with higher susceptibility to latent goal drift.
